Chemistry Atlas

Privacy policy

Updated November 20, 2026. Chemistry Atlas is an educational portfolio website for exploring chemistry lessons and classroom activities. The site is operated by Maahnoor Rajan. Contact: maahnoor.rajan12@gmail.com.

Google sign-in

We request your Google name, email address and basic profile information to create your account and recognize you when you return. Google may provide a profile picture as part of this information. Supabase processes authentication and stores your account information. We do not receive your Google password. We do not request access to Gmail, Drive, contacts or other Google account content.

Classroom records

When you use classroom features, we store class membership, assignments, due dates, quiz answers and scores, notebook observations, feedback and teacher-access requests. These records support assignments and progress tracking. Your teacher can view records submitted in their classes. Site administrators can review teacher requests and manage the service. Do not enter sensitive personal information in notebooks or quiz answers.

Storage and service providers

The Vercel website uses Supabase for authentication and PostgreSQL storage. Vercel processes web requests and may retain operational logs, such as request metadata, for service operation and troubleshooting. The earlier ChatGPT Sites edition stores its classroom records in its hosted database. Google, Supabase, Vercel and the earlier hosting provider process data according to their own service policies. Data may be processed outside your country.

Cookies and browser storage

Essential secure cookies keep you signed in and protect the authentication flow. Demo cookies identify an isolated sample workspace and expire after three hours. Browser storage may keep language preferences, temporary observation drafts and video progress. Expired demo data may remain stored until cleanup. We have not added advertising trackers or advertising analytics.

External videos

YouTube videos load through YouTube's privacy-enhanced player. Google and YouTube process video requests and playback interactions under their policies. Links to outside resources are governed by those sites' policies.

Use, retention and choices

We use account and learning data to provide the website, protect access and troubleshoot problems. We do not sell Google user data, use it for advertising or use it to train AI models. Account and classroom records remain stored until removed by the operator; there is no automatic retention deadline for regular accounts. To request account or learning-record access, correction or deletion, email the operator from the account's email address. You can also revoke Google access in your Google Account connections settings; revoking access does not itself delete stored classroom records.

Students and updates

Teachers should use school-approved arrangements for student participation and supervise practical activities. Anyone can browse lessons and try the isolated demos without creating a personal account. We will update this page when the site's data practices change.
